Usage, billing and frequently asked questions

Built around your workflow

One Vector OS account. Your engineering workspace.

Access supported Vector OS capabilities across the desktop application, web workspace, and available native engineering integrations—without purchasing a separate subscription for each interface.

Complex engineering operations may consume multiple standard edits. Applicable usage is shown before execution. Features depend on supported applications, releases, and plan entitlements.

Capacity that matches your engineering work.

Compare the intended monthly edit allowances. More involved tasks and premium reasoning may use multiple standard edits; the applicable usage is shown before execution.

View all monthly allowances

A bounded task. A clear estimate.

An edit is a bounded, authorized engineering task. Plan the change, review the selected context and approve the operation before supported execution. Internal model calls and native API calls are not separate customer edits.

Your allowance renews monthly.

Quarterly or yearly billing does not change the monthly allowance or grant all edits upfront. Included unused edits do not roll over. Ultra provides the highest standard-plan capacity; it is not unlimited.

These are planned launch allowances, not a current account balance. Model availability, context capabilities and native operations depend on qualified releases and server-authorized plan entitlements.
